headline: Delhivery plans to add 2,000 EVs in 18 months and electrify half its intra-city fleet

modes.bear: Upfront capital expenditure for EV fleet deployment could strain near-term financials.

summary: Logistics major Delhivery is rolling out 2,000 electric vehicles over the next 18 months as part of a wider plan to integrate 5,000 electric commercial vehicles into its fleet within three years. The initiative aims to make 50% of the company's intra-city fleet electric in two to three years. For retail investors, the shift highlights growing corporate focus on sustainable logistics and potential long-term operating cost optimization. Delhivery shares are listed on the National Stock Exchange under the ticker DELHIVERY.
